name: Kanlungan
desc: A concept brief for Kanlungan, a fictional interior design studio with a small furniture shop. The studio isn't real and nothing is built yet. The repo holds the brief only.

p: Kanlungan is a made-up business I'm using as a portfolio piece. The idea is a premium interior design studio first and a small furniture and homeware shop second, with a warm modern Filipino look. The Filipino part is meant to show up in materials and craft instead of decorative motifs.
[Why this was built, in a sentence.]

The studio offers two services. Full-Service Furnishing takes an empty, already-built space to move-in ready. The Design-Only Interior Package gives the client the plans and specifications to buy and install themselves.

The shop has seven categories, from seating to art, and mixes Kanlungan's own pieces with makers who are mostly Philippine. One test decides what gets in. Would Kanlungan confidently specify the piece in one of its own finished spaces? Generic furniture, major appliances and construction materials are out.
So far the repo is a README of these decisions. There's no site or design yet.
